name: kettlebell one legged deadlift
description: A single-leg hip hinge holding a kettlebell. It trains the hamstrings and glutes and challenges your balance.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand on the opposite leg with a soft knee.
Hinge forward at the hip and extend your free leg straight back.
Lower the bell toward the floor while keeping your back flat.
Stop when your torso is about parallel to the floor.
Squeeze your glute to return upright, then switch legs.
